alcohol_va_masking.enological_rule: High alcohol (>=11.5%) mitigates consumer rejection of moderate volatile acidity up to 0.60 g/L.

molecular_so2_equilibrium.enological_rule: At lower pH (<3.30), a lower Free SO2 dose achieves equal antimicrobial efficacy.

sulphate_chloride_balance.enological_rule: Sulphates/Chlorides ratio > 6.0 correlates with superior aging potential and clean finish.
